title: Remarks on the Complex Structures on $\mathbb P^3$ and $S^2\times S^4$
summary: Assuming the validity of the recently proposed \textit{``A compact complex threefold fibred by tori over the projective line, and the six-sphere''}, we construct an exotic complex structure on $\mathbb P^{3}$, distinct from the point-blowup structures of Huckleberry, Kebekus, and Peternell. Then we perform an Atiyah flop to produce a complex structure on the standard smooth manifold $S^{2}\times S^{4}$.
